name: Bernd Lange - Proposition de la Commission
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the adjustment of customs duties on the import of certain goods originating in the United States of America and opening of tariff quotas for imports of certain goods originating in the United States of America
part_text:
The report sets out Parliament's position on a planned EU law that would cut or remove EU import duties on certain goods from the United States, as part of a trade deal. Parliament wants the benefits to start only once the United States meets set conditions, to last only until 31 March 2028, and to be paused if the United States breaks the deal or harms EU industries. It also adds safeguards for EU farmers and producers.

- Tariff cuts on US goods apply only after the US meets conditions, until 31 March 2028.
- EU producers and farmers gain a safeguard: imports rising over 10% trigger a review.
- Parliament votes on this position; talks with EU governments follow.
